content:
The age of the universe is approximately **13.8 billion years** (more precisely, 13.787 ± 0.020 billion years).

This estimate comes primarily from measurements of the cosmic microwave background radiation by satellites like WMAP and Planck, combined with observations of the universe's expansion rate and the oldest known stars. This age represents the time since the Big Bang, when the universe began expanding from an extremely hot, dense state.
